oliver (Product Design): quick sync Figma: https://go.fig/redwood/forms/compact-validate main topics: required marker patterns in compact tables, inline row validation vs top summary, and destructive confirmation UX (undo vs typed confirm). need quick takes before next-week design review. maya (Design): TL;DR: inline errors for row edits (immediate feedback). top summary for aggregate counts (clickable to jump to first error). For required fields in tight lists: asterisk + sr-only "required" is OK; for legal/compliance fields show full "Required" label. rees (PM): ops note: accidental destructive ops cost invoices/time. prefer typed confirm for large batches, but too heavy for small edits. make threshold configurable per org. izzy (Eng): implementation bits: typed confirm flow should disable primary until match, server-side recheck before applying change, and avoid auto-focus on mobile (keyboard hides CTA). for inline errors, use reserved row height to avoid layout jump. paz (A11y): a11y checklist: 1) asterisk alone is not sufficient add sr-only or text label. 2) error summary should be role="alert" and focusable. 3) when moving between modal steps, announce "Step X of Y" via aria-live. 4) don't rely on color alone. maya (Design): two patterns for destructive confirm we sketched: - Soft: single modal + undo toast (default undo 2m) - Hard: stepper with typed confirm (exact word) for large deletes or compliance-required orgs Which to default to? rees (PM): proposal: default to soft for < N rows, hard for >= N rows. N=25 is my starting point. expose in admin as "typed_confirm_threshold". track metrics and adjust. izzy (Eng): engineering caveat: paste events in confirm input can be abused. we should allow paste but verify exact match server-side and log paste events separately. also debounce client-side validation so users aren't blocked by small network lag. paz (A11y): sample ARIA guidance for confirm modal: ```html
2 rows need attention
Step 2 of 2: Confirm removal
Case-sensitive. Matches only "REMOVE".
``` Also: for keyboard users, focus should land on the alert or the first interactive element depending on context. test VoiceOver and NVDA. oliver (Product Design): copy nits: avoid punitive language. prefer: "This will remove access for N members. You can undo this action for 2 minutes." Hard confirm copy: "To permanently remove access, type REMOVE and press Confirm." Keep language consistent across console. infra-bot: telemetry checklist: emit events: form_submit_attempt, row_error_displayed, row_error_resolved, bulk_action_open, bulk_confirm_attempt, bulk_confirm_success, bulk_confirm_cancel, bulk_undo_clicked. include metadata: org_id, user_role, device_type, affected_count, confirm_type. izzy (Eng): mobile UX: if keyboard obscures CTA, move CTA into sticky footer inside modal. trap focus and ensure Esc closes modal. avoid moving focus away from top-level content unexpectedly. rees (PM): decision draft: 1) Inline errors + top summary is default. 2) Default confirm = soft (undo 2m). 3) Hard confirm (typed) for >=25 rows or org toggle. 4) Expose admin setting for undo window and typed_confirm_threshold. 5) A/B test this for 6w: measure accidental_removal_rate, completion_time, support_contacts. maya (Design): i'll update mocks to show asterisk + sr-only, top summary anchor behavior, and both confirm variants. include microcopy variations. paz (A11y): i'll run quick checklist and share regression tests for VoiceOver/NVDA. oliver (Product Design): thanks team. next: maya to push mocks, izzy to estimate, paz to run a11y, infra-bot to create telemetry ticket. follow-up on Thu 10am. :calendar:
